 ELECTRIC SERVICE - LARGE LOAD

                    AGREED MOTION TO EXTEND BRIEFING DEADLINES

         Southwestern Electric Power Company (SWEPCO) submits, on behalf of all the parties to

this proceeding, this agreed motion to extend the current briefing deadlines approved in SOAH

Order No. 5. Counsel for SWEPCO has conferred with counsel for Commission Staff, the Office

of Public Utility Counsel, Texas Industrial Energy Consumers, Eastman Chemical Company, and

Cities Advocating Reasonable Deregulation, and is authorized to state that those parties agree to

an extension of the current briefing deadlines to allow the parties additional time to negotiate a

potential settlement without simultaneously continuing litigation.

         In the event the parties cannot reach an agreement during this time, the parties agree to file

their briefs in accordance with the following revised deadlines:

           Initial Briefs                             September 3, 2026

           Reply Briefs                               September 11, 2026

         SWEPCO requests that the ALJ enter an order adopting the above agreed to briefing

deadlines for this proceeding and granting SWEPCO any additional relief to which it may be

entitled.
